consequence.statement: The removed `-s3.sse-encryption` config is no longer honoured; S3 server-side encryption must be configured with the `-s3.sse.*` settings.

original.statement: The deprecated Loki config `-s3.sse-encryption` is removed in favor of the `-s3.sse.*` settings.

decision.reason: [ev-621f5e4bbeea] says the deprecated `-s3.sse-encryption` config was removed and the `-s3.sse.*` settings replace it. A removed setting is no longer honoured, which is exactly what setting-ignored covers ("removed/renamed key"), and swapping in the `-s3.sse.*` settings is the right remediation. The evidence does not say whether a leftover value is silently ignored or makes startup fail, so setting-ignored is the minimum the evidence supports, not a proven outcome.
